snippet.title: Shapez 2 - Official Trailer | Mundo Gamer Showcase 2026 - Edition 01
snippet.description:
Are you ready to build limitless factories in space?

Shapez 2 is a pure factory-building experience where automation, efficiency, and scale are the ultimate goals.

Design massive multi-layered production lines, process complex shapes, and expand your operations across an infinite sandbox with no enemies or time pressure.

🛒 Add it to your Steam wishlist
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2162800/shapez_2/

🔥 About the Game

🏭 Massive Factory Building
• Create enormous factories across multiple layers
• Scale production with trains and interconnected systems

🔷 Shape-Based Automation
• Cut, stack, paint, and combine geometric shapes
• Build increasingly complex production chains

🚀 Infinite Expansion
• No limits, no enemies, no time pressure
• Focus entirely on optimization and creativity

🧠 Deep Optimization Systems
• Improve efficiency through logic and layout design
• Experiment freely with no penalties

⚙️ Multiple Game Modes
• Different difficulty levels for all types of players
• Unique challenges and progression systems

🔁 Endless Replayability
• Infinite combinations and factory designs
• Fully moddable experience with community support

🎮 Sandbox Freedom
• Build, destroy, and rebuild instantly
• Total control over your factory systems
